requirements.limitation: Dispatch and supported combinations are qualified only for the executed linear_static cases; DISCRETE is not claimed and no untested element/material/load combination is generalized.
Patch, constant-strain and rigid-body evidence is accepted only where mathematically applicable and present in the existing family tests; no universal family-wide patch claim is made.
The decision applies to the executed supported nodal/distributed load cases and their declared boundary conditions; it is not a claim for unsupported load conventions.
Existing linear isotropic material routes are bounded by the executed evidence. Orthotropic and laminate extensions remain explicitly non-qualified and do not receive maturity promotion.
The new predeclared four-level HEX8 response series passes, but broader family-wide refinement and quality/distortion evidence is not sufficient for an unrestricted requirement claim.
The controlled invalid-input corpus covers the identified G04 categories; future API additions require their own rejection contracts.

Code_Aster and CalculiX are unavailable. This does not block the bounded 0.2.6 G04 decision, but an external campaign is required before any release claim that includes external correlation. SKIPPED_UNAVAILABLE is not PASS.
This closeout remains a branch-local Owner decision; global gate consolidation is intentionally deferred to the multi-agent integration.

explicit_limitations: G04-LIN-005 remains deferred for broader family-wide mesh quality/distortion evidence.
